notes.title: Caution, award opportunity ahead!
notes.notes: [h1]Ossu![/h1][p][/p][p]Drifters, if you’ve been enjoying JDM maybe you can help us win an award?! JDM: Japanese Drift Master has been nominated for awards in the DevGAMM Awards 2025. [/p][p]You can cast your community vote [b][url="https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025"]HERE[/url][/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The voting ends October 5. You will need to register your email address to be eligible to vote. Be aware that once you make your pick, you won’t be able to change your mind.[/p][p][/p][p][url=https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/a0208bd0ced2f025df3330551c568ba71bd2a8d6.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Why vote for us?[/h2][p]That’s easy! Because you like us! :) We’re as much players of JDM as you are, and we’ve been listening to your feedback and requests long before the game even came out. After the launch we’ve been extremely busy fixing issues you found, improving features you requested, while at the same time providing an abundance of free content: from new game modes, to story expansions, new cars and even completely new features. By working together we make JDM a better experience every day, and we all deserve some recognition! [/p][p][/p][p]Propaganda aside, there’s a multitude of awesome games being nominated, so scroll through available options [b][url="https://devgamm.com/awards2025/games"]HERE[/url][/b][url="https://devgamm.com/awards2025/games"] [/url]to cast your votes. That being said, we will be humbled by any vote that goes our way - thank you![/p][p][/p][p]As always, we extend our invitation to join our Discord server, where you can talk to like-minded people and directly with us. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Happy voting! Let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]GAMING FACTORY - UPCOMING RELEASES[/h3][p]We're not only a developer but also a publisher. notes.title: Community goodies and a new Complete Beginner's Guide
notes.notes: [h1]Ossu![/h1][p][/p][p]Drifters, we have some cool stuff for you! First and foremost, we’re going into a sale today - for the next 2 weeks you will be able to grab JDM: Japanese Drift Master with [b]a 30% discount.[/b] [/p][p]To convince you that JDM is a good investment, here’s a long gameplay, which explains the core concepts behind the game. The video covers the uncut beginning of the experience, so be warned of spoilers. In the video we also provide a few tips and tricks on drifting in JDM (and in general on drifting in any game) so if you’re new to the topic it might be a worthy watch. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="iZpYUJQ5Ji4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Even More Goodies[/h2][p]Recently, a few people from the community reached out asking about wallpapers with the characters from our story, so we happily obliged :) .[/p][p]We’ve added a few new wallpapers to our Community folder, which you can find on our Google Drive, [b][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1be_Cbu0TabDE_JUxOwt-q2_IqkLO8lhz?usp=sharing"]HERE »[/url][/b]. Take a look, set them up on your desktops and let us know which one is your favorite! [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/34ce5b791c14f4690360d240cca3ce0ed3d9bf0b.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Sneak Peek![/h2][p]You probably noticed that we’ve been a little bit quiet lately, however, there’s a really good reason behind this - we’re tirelessly working on our next major update. As promised, we will deliver a few, very much requested from the day the game launched, features.[/p][p]Here’s a sneak peek of the upcoming Car Setup system expansion, which will unlock more modifications to the rims and tires:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/f82067a22cca3d79416e3a44b147de5a611258d0.png"][/img][/p][p]We can’t wait to give you access to the updated Car Setup system, but we still have some bug fixing to do, as well as some additional polishing work ahead of us, so please be patient! [/p][p]We’re aiming to release the next major patch at the end of September, which will also include even more cool additions.[/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, please stay in touch with us through our Discord server.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]GAMING FACTORY - UPCOMING RELEASES[/h3][p]We're not only a developer but also a publisher. If you like JDM, take a look at what other titles we have gearing up for launch. Who knows, maybe you'll come to love them, as much as we do! [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks! notes.title: Three more photos have reached the finish line! Let's meet the winners
notes.notes: [h1]Ossu![/h1][p][/p][p]This is what we’ve been waiting for, dear artists! It’s our pleasure to reveal the next three winners of our Photo Mode contest! With so many fantastic entries submitted, the competition was tough, however, thanks to your votes, we managed to select the real gems.[/p][p]And so, the creations of our winners will soon appear on the in-game loading screens as beautiful backgrounds, and their authors will receive a special role on our Discord server, recognizing them as esteemed members of our community.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eCEyQHRSZLY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]The three fan-favorite screenshots will soon be added to JDM as loading screen backgrounds![/h3][p][/p][p]Our winners’ shots will now be immortalized as in-game loading screen backgrounds, coming with the next update to the game, proudly displaying the creators’ names. A true way to make your mark in Guntama’s history! [/p][p][/p][h3]And now, without further ado - the winners![/h3][olist][*][p]FilipQn729- with 26 votes[/p][/*][*][p]KommyGER- with 24 votes[/p][/*][*][p]28 Gøld - with 23 votes[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2][b]FilipQn729[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/3591ea6b6c4177a69d85eacc14607288bd96d57f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]KommyGER[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/dc3256c082d7a4d0d15f9057690fdea202ae7de6.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]28 Gøld[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/ca9ea9b039f083ce0ada82dae85176ad966761f2.png"][/img][/p][h3]Didn’t win this time? No worries, the next round starts now![/h3][p][/p][p]We'd like to remind you that the Photo Mode Contest is a recurring event, with three winners. So if you just missed out on winning this time, don't give up. Your new screenshots have a chance to win in future editions. Remember that the Contest takes place on our [url="https://discord.gg/NGD8uBQ24E"]Discord [/url]server, so if you want to join in on the fun, first join our awesome drifting community. We can’t wait to see your amazing snaps! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Just a friendly reminder - the contest rules:[/h3][p][/p][p]1. Use the Photo Mode feature to take a stunning shot of your car in the beautiful surroundings (you can find your screenshots saved in the JDM game folder at C: | Program Files(x86) | Steam | steamapps | common | JDM | JDM | Photos[/p][p]2. Remember to snap your scenes in a 2k resolution (2560x1440 px) .PNG format, without(!) game logo overlay, and a 16:9 ratio.[/p][p]3. Head over to our Discord server, where you'll find a #Creative-hub channel - this is where you can post your awesome shots[/p][p]4. Both our team and all Discord members can vote for their favorite works by leaving a "📸" reaction under them.[/p][p]5. This is an ongoing competition, where each month we will select three new winners - based on exactly the same rule[/p][p][/p][p][b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b] has always been a true passion project for us. We're committed to crafting the best racing experience possible - and to do that, we need your input and support. Join us on our Discord server and help shape the future of the game with your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]See you on Guntama roads, artists![/p][p] [/p][p]Let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h3]GAMING FACTORY - UPCOMING RELEASES[/h3][p]We're not only a developer but also a publisher. If you like JDM, take a look at what other titles we have gearing up for launch. Who knows, maybe you'll come to love them, as much as we do! [/p][p] Thanks! notes.title: A true celebration of Polish games
notes.notes:
[p]We’re happy to announce that JDM: Japanese Drift Master is part of the “Celebrating 10 years of Polish games at PAX” event on Steam. The showcase starts August 29th and ends September 1st. [/p][p][/p][p]Although we’re not directly on the showfloor of PAX West this year, we always have our fingers crossed for our fellow countrymen flying overseas to showcase their indie gems. If you’re looking to grab a new game to close out Summer or wishlist an upcoming title, you’ll definitely find something worth your while from the selected games. As in, something else as a bonus to JDM, which if you don’t own yet is a grave mistake that needs immediate fixing! :)[/p][p][/p][p]It’s also a perfect opportunity for us to make a shout-out to the Indie Games Polska foundation for a decade of supporting Polish development and helping us promote our games abroad. notes.title: Patch 1.6.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1][p] [/p][p]This week’s patch notes are primarily focused on some gameplay improvements based on your feedback coming from after the recent physics update. There are some highly anticipated grip improvements for driving during the rain, as well as additional overall grip balancing on different surfaces and for different weather conditions. We’ve also made a follow up to the gravity changes made in 1.6.0 with some beefy improvements to car collisions. [/p][p]As we’re gearing up for our next major update, where you will see more improvements and new features, we’re committed to working alongside our community to further polish the JDM experience. Please don’t be hesitant to try today’s changes and get back to us with feedback. Thanks![/p][p][/p][p]And now, off to the…[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Made overall collision improvements across the whole game. The collisions should now feel more impactful and the cars should feel as they have more weight to them.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Subaru Impreza WRX STI’s hood collisions - destructible objects should no longer get stuck in the car’s hood.
[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced the Handbrake and Clutch behaviour for AWD cars in the game. 
[/p][/*][*][p]Improved how the Handbrake and the Leg Brake behave and react when pushed simultaneously. 
[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the car grip on wet surfaces on all types of available roads in game (including grass).
[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the car grip on dry gravel and grass surfaces.

[/p][/*][/list][h3]System[/h3][list][*][p]Added the winning community screenshots as new loading screens in the game. The screenshots are the winning picks from our July Photo mode contest - once again, congrats to the winners![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/1137d11c74589f8e954086cef968b5b7b657c74b.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]As always, we encourage you to join our Discord server, where you may share your thoughts about the game and the changes we are implementing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p]

notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers![/h1][p]
[/p][p]We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for [b]Pizza Slice [/b]- our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from [b]August 26th[/b] until [b]September 16th[/b]. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"][u]Steam Store Page[/u][/url] and click the green [b]“Request Access[/b]” button to be viable for participation.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]🍕About Pizza Slice[/h3][hr][/hr][p align="justify"]If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area![/p][p][/p][h3]Game features:[/h3][list][*][p align="justify"][b]The Dream - [/b]Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis.
[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]The Business [/b]- owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]The Buzz[/b] - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores.
[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]A cozy simulation [/b]- the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business.
[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]A portion for two [/b]- you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🥓What can you expect from the build?[/h3][hr][/hr][p]A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.[/p][p][/p][p]The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.[/p][p][/p][p]Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?[/h3][hr][/hr][p]We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. [/p][p][/p][p]If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.[/p][p][/p][p]Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.[/p][p][/p][h3]Build Information & Requirements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Platform[/b]: Windows PC via Steam[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b]: Partial Support[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supported Languages[/b] - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardware Minimum Requirements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer[/p][/*][*][p]Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz[/p][/*][*][p]4 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p]Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x[/p][/*][*][p]DirectX 11[/p][/*][*][p]6 GB free HDD Space[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/e00c11da06afea0c97c450539317f9ff2161465d.png"][/img][/p][h3]🤌How to Join?[/h3][hr][/hr][olist][*][p]Go to the Pizza Slice Steam Page now. You can follow the link [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"][u]HERE[/u][/url].[/p][/*][*][p]Click on the [b]Request Access [/b]button found on the playtest section of the page.[/p][/*][*][p]That’s it! You’re signed in. Now patiently await for a confirmation email.[/p][/*][*][p]The playtests will begin on August 26th, 2025.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]👌Got questions?[/h3][hr][/hr][p]The easiest way to ask us questions is by joining our Discord server and asking us directly. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/ca8a78e67837c7bdc71acdec23388ed67505acc4.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]See you at the table, really soon![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p]

[h2]Ossu![/h2][p]

[/p][p]Drifters! Our friends from [b]Untold Tales[/b] have invited us to join the [i]From Poland With Love 2025![/i] Steam event and here we are! Between August 4th to 11th, [b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b] will retain its [b]-25% discount[/b]. If you haven’t grabbed the game yet, now is the best chance to do it. [/p][p][/p][p][b]JDM [/b]has recently undergone some significant changes, including a physics revamp to improve the overall driving experience; Received a new car - Honda NSX NA1 - completely for free, as well as a new side mission, which joined the Underground Missions roster. Updates were done to traffic and opponent AI and we’ve introduced pre-set cars with unique liveries to the Challenge Mode. We continue to evolve and expand the game alongside our community, so will you join and help shape the future of JDM: Japanese Drift Master?[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Have a taste for more? [i]From Poland With Love 2025![/i] is a celebration of creativity, passion and love for gaming coming directly from a country, which became a powerhouse of development in Europe. notes.notes:

Hotfix 1.6.1 notes:[/h2][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash occurring after selecting the career option.[/p][/*][*][p]Physics updates: Improved the feeling of drifting with reducing tendency of cars being pushed too much inside the corners instead of maintaining higher angles - less straightening in unwanted moments, smoother drifts. Reduced problems of loosing grip randomly while doing crucial corrections to keep the car under control.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Honda NSX NA1 (1992) - further suspension calibration - better fitment of wheels to body (can be lowered more), the stock suspension height is now also lower.[/p][/*][*][p]Honda NSX NA1 (1992) - fixed resetting suspension height after exiting the car setup menu to the open world.[/p][/*][*][p]PXN VD10 - added a preset bind / preset Force Feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]PXN V10 - added a preset Force Feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]PXN V99 - added a preset bind / preset Force Feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with event Points of Interest markers displaying different icons than intended.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]There is one more thing, Drifters...,[/h2][hr][/hr][p]So far, only a few % of you have shared their thoughts on JDM: Japanese Drift Master. notes.title: JDM joins the Steam Racing Fest
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1][p]
[/p][p]Steam Racing Fest just launched and we’re more than happy to be a part of it. Starting from today until August 11th you can grab the game at 25% off. [/p][p][/p][p]It’s a perfect opportunity to buy the game, if you’ve been on the fence until now. And if you’re still unsure if it’s worth it, take a look at the video below:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="s168sc66FD8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Oh, how time flies! It feels like we’ve released the game just a week ago and here we are - two major patches and a few more updates and hotfixes already behind us. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been closely watching and discussing with you the state of the game since day zero. We’ve gathered a lot of feedback, constructive criticism and a lot of words of encouragement since. We sincerely thank you for all the support! For now, let’s do a little deep dive on how much has changed:[/p][h3]
Optimization[/h3][p]Yes, we know there’s still space for improvement here and we are continuing to work on further optimization advancements, however since launch we minimized stuttering, added basic FSR support, added additional graphical settings and removed or added an ON/OFF option for a few settings based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3]Physics 2.0[/h3][p]The most recent addition to the game. You said that driving on a wheel is far from ideal and we were inclined to agree, hence a full rework of Force Feedback and additional changes done to global physics. We’ve also reworked the Arcade and Simcade models a bit, pushing them further apart from each other - now, both fully represent the style of play associated with their names. To learn more about those changes, visit our devlog [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1153410/view/510712822654566530"][u]HERE[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/da7f09b4a01f59bf6a740ff9e57daf0da467dc5a.png"][/img][/p][h3]AI updates[/h3][p]We were fiddling with AI improvements since the game launched and now we’re finally happy to say it’s in a good spot. We’ve reworked traffic to behave more realistically, as well as improved its general behaviour on tight mountain roads and on highways. AI opponents have also been revamped - actively seeking new best paths during the race and being more aware of other cars on the road, including the player’s.
[/p][h3]Tuning Accessibility[/h3][p]For those less tuning savvy, we’ve prepared an auto Car Setup feature. If you go into the Car Setup menu now, you will see three different setting options: stock, drift and grip. Selecting any of them will automatically set the car for that activity. Of course you can change those settings at any time you visit the Car Setup menu. Nothing stands in your way to swap a grip setup for a drift setup between events, using the same car. You can also go into manual settings and improve or change whatever feels better for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/07d802b97e8c31f853a2c7d5c8deaac4073a4db4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Photo Mode and Landmarks[/h3][p]By popular demand we’ve implemented a fully fleshed out Photo Mode, which you can activate at any time by going into the Pause Menu. To make the use of the mode more fun and engaging we have added a Landmarks activity to the game - find the landmark spots in the game and take a photo there using the Photo Mode to get extra car experience and an awesome screenshot to your collection. You can find and unlock those spots for every single car, so that your roaming across Guntama Prefecture never gets old. You can read up more about this feature [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1153410/view/510710285788512600"][u]HERE[/u][/url]. [/p][p][/p][h3]New Content[/h3][p]From a 9 mission long side story of Scorpion, through two new and completely free of charge cars, to additional new locations and side missions. Our plan is to continue expanding the world of JDM, so expect more and more content finding its way to the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/a8f603a0483cc6de12b10737cd452a879507ad8f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Obviously the list of changes, updates and fixes is far longer than the above mentions, however we’re already at the ‘beefy’ size of this devlog, so let’s stop here. [/p][p][/p][p]JDM: Japanese Drift Master is and always was a passion project for us. We’re trying to create the best possible racing experience and we need to do it alongside you and your feedback. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Celebrate the evolution of JDM with us during the [b]Steam’s Racing Fest![/b][/p][p]See you on Guntama roads![/p][p]
[/p][p]let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h3]GAMING FACTORY - UPCOMING RELEASES[/h3][p]We're not only a developer but also a publisher. If you like JDM, take a look at what other titles we have gearing up for launch. Who knows, maybe you'll come to love them, as much as we do! [/p][p]
Thanks!

notes.title: Major Update. Patch 1.6.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1][p][/p][p]We have been teasing the upcoming changes to the game throughout the entirety of  last week and now it's time to launch them live! [/p][p][/p][p]The scope of this update is based on your feedback and covers some of the items that received the most constructive criticism since the game launched in late May. Expect better car handling in both Arcade and Simcade physics models, as well as drastically improved driving experience when playing on a steering wheel. Force Feedback support has been revamped with additional settings and calibrations. We’ve also improved gravity physics for the game, as well as braking power, suspension work and tire grip. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re also introducing a new car to the fleet - Honda NSX NA1, and a completely new location - a multi story garage, which also serves as the location for a new Underground Side mission. [/p][p][/p][p]If you want a deep dive into some of the above topics, check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1153410/view/510712444576860037"][u]AI devlog[/u][/url] & the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1153410/view/510712822654566530"][u]Physics 2.0 devlog[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][p]And now, without further ado:[/p][h2]
Patch Notes:[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]Physics 2.0[/h3][p]We’ve revamped the overall physics in the game focusing on car suspension, brakes and tires, to improve the overall driving experience across both physics models.[/p][p]We’ve completely reworked the Force Feedback system, to greatly improve handling the game on a steering wheel. [/p][p][/p][p]Some  additional notes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved the auto flip physics behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked car airborne physics. The car will now have more weight when airborne. Added cinematic cameras to big jumps.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the grip parameters across the whole game in both Arcade and in Simcade physics models.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved gravity physics. The cars will now have more weight and more realistic physics when colliding with other objects.
These are the initial global changes we've already implemented alongside the bigger Physics 2.0 update. However, our plan is to continue working on this aspect in the following weeks, expanding it with a proper collisions system for each car. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved braking power for all cars (noticeable in Simcade, heavily adjusted in Arcade).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our next step for this process is to expand the supported wheel presets with premade FFB settings presets. We estimate that by the end of summer the full list of currently supported steering wheels will receive a preset update for FFB.[/p][h3]
AI Improvements[/h3][p]We’ve improved AI across traffic and opponent behaviour. [/p][p]Traffic cars are now smarter - they are more mindful about the player’s position and speed and react more accordingly. We’ve targeted two main aspects of their behaviour: highways - they will now be less inclined to change lanes and move out of the player’s way, unless they are driving at high speed directly behind them. They will also change lanes more frequently, forcing the player to be more mindful when speeding on the freeways; tight, mountain roads - the traffic should now be less congested in those areas and the cars will no longer drive immediately one behind the other, leaving space for the player to manoeuvre between them. [/p][p]Opponents - they are also now smarter and will actively seek the best possible route to take to win the race. They will also be more mindful about other cars, including the player, when driving. [/p][p][/p][p]Some additional notes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved AI opponent drift interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced the routes that opponents take during events[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Car - Honda NSX NA1 (1992)[/h3][p]We’ve added a new fan favourite car to the game - the NSX you’ve all been asking for: NA1.[/p][p]There are also three bodykits available to purchase from the tuning shop for it:[/p][list][*][p]Phantom Veil Widebody[/p][/*][*][p]L3GENN Widebody[/p][/*][*][p]Griptide Tuning Kit Widebody[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/14c1fc9b1c5487b57dfacfaaee24fe7c8088aaa3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new camera angle to the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new location to the game - a multi story garage. You can find it in the Guntama Port Area. A new Underground Side Mission has been added using this location.[/p][/*][*][p]Challenge mode. Added new, preset cars with custom livery designs to the challenge mode (grip and drift).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved handbrake handling on 4 wheel drive cars.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]System[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a variety of crashes reported by the community. [/p][/*][*][p]Further improvements of game optimization, including VRAM and texture notes.title: Upcoming changes - Physics 2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu! [/h1][p]
[/p][p]Drifters, we’ve got some good news for all of you and especially the people who play on a steering wheel. In the upcoming patch expect to see major changes done to the overall driving experience. We’re overhauling some of our physics systems, focusing a lot of our attention towards the tire and suspension physics. These changes will be felt across all input devices - gamepad, keyboard and, most importantly, steering wheels. [/p][p][/p][p]The changes are targeted at drastically improving the grip racing experience, but also to enhance the overall feel and control of the cars you are driving.  

We’re also expanding our support for Force Feedback, which will significantly improve car behaviour when playing on a wheel. There’s a lot of additional configuration options happening under the hood for FFB that will not only make it easier to just plug and play using a wheel but will also make the driving experience feel smoother and more realistic.[/p][p][/p][p]The above introduced changes will influence both the arcade and simcade physics models, where the arcade physics will now feel more ‘arcade’y’ and simcade will feel a little more realistic.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BR8U1HH_JWE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We’ve been following your feedback since launch day and this patch means to resolve the most pressing issues reported by you. Here are a few examples of what to expect:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p][b]Force Feedback[/b] - we’ve made a deep dive into our systems and reworked the support for FFB from the ground up. We are also upgrading our in-game setup - you will find more settings to fiddle with and tailor the driving experience just the way you want. This is a major step forward but not the end of the road - we’ve circled back to available steering wheel presets and are modifying them accordingly to changes made in the engine. We will also be adding FFB presets to those setups per wheel. This process will probably take until the end of summer, but the first batch of supported wheels will come alongside the upcoming update. More on that on patch day.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Oversteering [/b]- with the overhaul of the physics in our engine and improvements made to tire and suspension behaviour you should no longer experience uncontrollable oversteering while playing on a wheel. The changes done to Force Feedback will also improve the general feeling of control you have over your car. The above modifications, alongside the automatic car setup system we’ve recently introduced, should drastically enhance the overall experience of driving in JDM.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arcade vs Simcade physics models[/b] - we’ve made a deep dive into both of our physics models and both were overhauled to better represent their target player bases.[/p][p]Arcade will now feel more… well arcade :) The overall driving experience will be easier with more overall grip for all cars, as well as it will be more effortless to maintain a drift.[/p][p]Simcade will feel a little bit more realistic now, especially in the handling department:  turning will feel smoother and the overall driving experience more enjoyable. [/p][p]All in all, the difference between the two models will now be more tangible, separating both models further apart and as such better representing the driving experience you can expect from both of them. 
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gravity [/b]- we’ve revamped some of our gravity settings, to improve car behaviour while in air - both big and small jumps will now feel more impactful and you will be able to feel the proper weight of the car. These changes will also influence the car’s behaviour during collisions, adding more weight to the cars and reacting more realistically during crashes. 
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Braking [/b]- changes done to the game’s physics will also impact braking. At low speeds braking will be significantly faster and more reactive. At fast speeds, braking will be more impactful in general. With the suspension physics adjustments you will also see how your car works on the road, improving the feel for the car.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/da7f09b4a01f59bf6a740ff9e57daf0da467dc5a.png"][/img][/p][p]To reiterate - our goal for this update is to greatly improve the driving experience, especially for our steering wheel drivers. If you’ve played the game previously and were discouraged by car handling, the upcoming patch will be a great moment to jump back in and check the new additions. [/p][p][/p][p]We will continue working on further improvements, so your feedback will be of utmost importance. notes.title: Upcoming changes - next major patch sneak peek.
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1][p][/p][p]
The next major patch is coming next week, so we wanted to give you a little sneak peek into what will be changing. Without further ado, let’s dive in:
[/p][h3]AI Improvements[/h3][hr][/hr][p]The AI improvements will touch on two different aspects of the game: open world traffic and opponent behaviour during events. 
[/p][p]Let’s start with events, as it is a more pressing issue for most of our drivers. We’ve improved AI inputs for the opponents - they are now more fluent, ensuring that every action they take is based on the same principles a player’s car would. The result is a more natural and realistic behavior of the AI. The opponents will also be smarter on the track, looking for the best possible route for them based on a variety of factors and will take into account other cars to calculate their reaction. Because of this the AI should be a little more predictable and definitely less destructive to your races.[/p][p][/p][p]In terms of traffic, we’ve completely redone our detection system and updated the traffic behaviour, ensuring that life on the road feels more realistic. Our efforts were primarily focused on highways, where the traffic would always turn to the left road lane, to avoid the incoming player. Now the cars will behave more naturally and will react to the players’ speed and the road maneuvers they make as they get close by. This will ensure a more life-like experience. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also looked into occasional traffic jams on the narrow mountain passes and the rural tight roads - the traffic will now be more scattered and less congested, allowing players to manoeuvre between cars when moving through the open world. [/p][p][/p][h3]Livery additions to the Challenge mode[/h3][hr][/hr][p]To make the Challenge Mode even more fun, we are adding custom created cars to the fray. They will come pre-tuned (and well set-up for either grip or drift races), including one of a kind, eye-pleasing custom liveries.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/57b3588fb024fd396e3819110d0e7656f41ba2a9.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the first, minor step we are taking in our mission of creating a fully customizable decals system in the game. It will take us some additional time to cook, but expect it to come to the game in Autumn. [/p][p][/p][h3]A new Underground Side Mission race[/h3][hr][/hr][p]Inspired by [i]Tokyo Drift’s [/i]scene, the new Underground Side Mission will take you to a multi-level garage, in which you climb to the top floor and then down again to street level, all within a certain amount of time, of course, and with a drift score goal in mind.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/1b0e9afbbf9ca350d44f83f9ec0a0be24e350a45.png"][/img][/p][p]You will also be able to visit the garage in the open world. You will find it in the Guntama Port area. [/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We’ve got more big news lined-up for the upcoming patch and the above is but a pre-taste, a Part 01 if you will. Other, truly major, changes are being tested as we publish this devlog. As previously promised, one of them is all about the driving experience dedicated to our steering wheel drifters. Be on the lookout for a new announcement on this topic closer to the week’s end.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, we’re more than happy to discuss with you not only the upcoming changes to the game but anything JDM related. Join our Discord server to never miss a beat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h3]GAMING FACTORY - UPCOMING RELEASES[/h3][p]We're not only a developer but also a publisher. If you like JDM, take a look at what other titles we have gearing up for launch. Who knows, maybe you'll come to love them, as much as we do! 
Thanks!

notes.title: Strike a Pose: Photo Mode Contest is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1][p][/p][p] It’s time to unleash your inner automotive artist in the brand-new Photo Mode Contest… but before we get to the point, let us say that we are super happy to see that Photo Mode, a feature highly requested by our amazing players, has become such a hit with the community! Whether you’re drifting through neon-lit streets, mountain passes, or peaceful countryside roads, you can now pause the action and capture your most breathtaking moments in full detail.    [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve seen your passion first-hand, right on our Discord server, which is already overflowing with amazing player-made screenshots. So, we thought: let’s give our community an event they deserve to go even further. With Photo Mode, you can now fine-tune your camera to capture the full vibe of your drift journey… and go down in Guntama history!  [/p][p][/p][h2]Show off your skills and make your way to the in-game loading screens[/h2][hr][/hr][p]All right, it’s time to get even more creative! To celebrate the new feature, we’re launching the [b]Photo Mode Screenshot Contest that will take place on our Discord server. [/b] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eCEyQHRSZLY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You can find all the necessary details and rules [url="https://jdmgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Photo-Mode-Contest-Rules-1.pdf"]HERE »[/url], but to pique your interest, let us add that the best screenshots from our community will find their way into JDM: Japanese Drift Master as amazing, unique, and completely one-of-a-kind loading screens... with your nicknames on them! What better opportunity to leave your everlasting mark on the world of Guntama, right? To sweeten the deal, champions will be granted a shiny new role on our Discord server, giving them lifetime bragging rights for their photography skills!  [/p][p][/p][h2]Here is a shortened version of the [url="https://jdmgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Photo-Mode-Contest-Rules-1.pdf"]Contest rules »[/url][/h2][hr][/hr][p]Although the Contest rules are pretty straightforward, we strongly recommend reviewing the full guidelines to avoid possible issues or disqualification. The following summary is only to familiarize you with the general assumptions of the event. With that behind us, let’s dive in!

[b]1.[/b] Use the new Photo Mode feature to take a stunning shot of your car in the beautiful surroundings (you can find your screenshots saved in the JDM game folder at [b]C: | Program Files(x86) | Steam | steamapps | common | JDM | JDM | Photos[/b]

[b]2.[/b] Remember to snap your scenes in a 2k resolution (2560x1440 px) .PNG format, without(!) game logo overlay, and a 16:9 ratio.

[b]3.[/b] Head over to our Discord server, where you'll find a #Creative-hub channel - this is where you can post your awesome shots

[b]4.[/b] From July 4th until the end of the month, both our team and all Discord members can vote for their favorite works by leaving a "📸" reaction under them.

[b]5.[/b] The three highest rated works will be included in the game as loading screens… with your Discord nicknames on them!

[b]6.[/b] This is an ongoing competition, where each month we will select three new winners - based on exactly the same rules.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/0612a78b5418b623334d9b8c17ca61575a14d421.png"][/img][/p][p]Pretty simple, isn’t it? We can't wait to see your amazing shots, especially since we have already seen a sample of your skills on Social Media and our Discord server. Speaking of which - if you are not a member of our server yet, you can join the crew now [b][url="https://discord.gg/NGD8uBQ24E"]in here »[/url][/b]  Every month is another chance to win, so grab your camera, set up your dream scene and immortalize your work in JDM: Japanese Drift Master! See you there![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][h3]
Thank you,

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Ossu![/b][/h1][p]
[/p][p]Summer is upon us, but it hasn’t slowed us down. Today we have a major patch for you, which brings some serious updates to the game. We’ve already teased the return of Scorpion and here it is - a whole new (technically speaking - brought back) side story campaign about the drifting beginnings of Hatori “Scorpion” Hasashi. If you want to learn more about the new content, go [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1153410/view/510709651799540237"]HERE[/url][/u]. [/p][p][/p][p]We also have some very avidly requested features making their way into the game: Photomode, anyone? It’s packed with camera settings, filters and is available at the push of that smartphone button. Have fun! [/p][p]To make this addition even more entertaining, we’ve prepared a new activity - Landmarks. Look for landmark spots in the open world, take a picture there and earn a beefy sum of reputation for your car. [/p][p][/p][p]On the technical side of things, we’re finally bringing FSR support, which comes alongside adjustments for the rest of the upscalers, frame generation tweaks and some improvements for the graphical settings autodetection.[/p][p]We’ve added HDR support and further improved performance in various regions of the map.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh! and there’s a new car waiting for you at the Car Dealer - Subaru Impreza GR STI. [/p][p]More cars are on their way and we’re carefully looking at your favourite suggestions as we move forward with upcoming car content, so please be patient as we cook. [/p][p][/p][p]All these new features are launching alongside one of the biggest sales on Steam. [b]We’re cutting the price of JDM by 25%[/b], so it's a perfect opportunity for you to hop in and enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]Before we move to the full patch notes, we wanted to celebrate the coming of summer with you, with a fresh new trailer, enjoy![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2OOl9oAf_bM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]System[/h3][list][*][p]Added Photomode to the game.[/p][p][i]To enter the Photomode, open the Smartphone and select Photomode. In the Photomode you will have full free camera movement as well as a plethora of options to choose from to make the best possible shot. Have fun! [/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added the FSR upscaler support.[/p][p][i]For the time being it doesn't yet support Frame Generation, but we are working on it! [/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Introduced some improvements for all upscalers, as well as their compatibility with various hardware. Upscalers also received a new profile "Quality Plus".[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Introduced some improvements for Frame Generation settings. [/p][p][i]The Frame Generation systems which are supported by your hardware will now be clearly communicated to you (will not be grayed out). Frame Generation has been disabled in the Main Menu screens.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Improved the gamepad input system recognition.[/p][p][i]A proper button mapping for Xbox as well as PlayStation gamepads should now be properly recognized by the game. Please be aware that the Steam Input should be turned off in Steam settings. You can also change the button icons from the Gameplay Menu Options > Icon Set.[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a basic anti-cheat function.[/p][p][i]Added a simple score filter to the Challenge Mode to automatically delete unobtainable and unrealistic scores. This is only the beginning of our fight with cheaters.[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p]Added native HDR support.[/p][p][i]You will find a new toggle in the Graphics menu allowing you to turn HDR on. To adjust the details go to the Adjust Brightness menu afterwards.[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the autodetection of graphical settings.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Added the [b]Rise of the Scorpion [/b]side missions campaign,[/p][p][i]After completing Chapter 01, Mission 05 a new Scorpion marker will show up on the map, which will initiate the Side Story campaign. There are 8 missions in total to beat. If completed, rewards you with the Scorpion's tuned Nissan Z33 (livery included).[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added Car Setup Profiles. [/p][p][i]When entering the Car Setup menu you will now see three predefined setups for your active car, for Drift, Grip and Stock settings. If you want to manually change the settings you can pick Custom Settings and modify your car in the same way as you could before.[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Landmarks Activity for the game.[/p][p][i]You can now look for landmark spots across the whole open world. For finding the spot and making a photo of your car in it, using the Photomode, you will be rewarded with a large amount of car reputation points. [/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Improved the braking system strength on arcade mode and braking system pressure on simcade at lower speeds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the lighting in all of the shops could break. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance in the Open World in various regions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional destructible barriers in various parts of the world.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with traffic routes and GPS navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'roof' camera angle during races against the Honey Badger.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the wrong driver would sit behind the wheel in Chapter 05, Mission 04.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a camera issue, where it would go through the Dekotora Truck in the garage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI / HUD[/h3][list][*][p]Updated the keybinding infographic for the keyboard in the input settings. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Fast Travel pop-up screen. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the RGB colour picker image in the Paint Shop.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Cars[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the starting car - Alpha Moriyamo.[/p][p][i]The Alpha Moriyamo will now have more horsepower, a basic nitro and a better exhaust when you buy it for the first time. You will also be able to get a free spoiler in the Tuner Shop for the car.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added a new car to the Car Dealer - Subaru Impreza GV STI.[/p][p][i]The car is an AWD and costs 5,500,000 Yen.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added new Visual Parts to be purchased in the Tuner Shop for the Subaru Impreza WRX STI.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Adjusted Nissan S14's drag race gear shift ranges.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/a411338e3424dd3875cdc7bb5ad090ec2f78588e.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for supporting [b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]We’re continuing to expand and evolve the game, here are some of our focus points at this time:[/p][list][*][p]Further improvements and adjustments to steering wheels - primarily Force Feedback feeling, fixing the oversteering issues and bringing in more steering wheels and input peripherals presets.[/p][/*][*][p]Car setup expansion with customizable wheel and rim options.[/p][/*][*][p]A car livery system.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck graphical preset.[/p][/*][/list][p]
As always, if you encounter any issues, please send us a bug report [u][url="https://jdmgame.com/drift-hub/bug-reports/"]HERE[/url][/u]. We understand that we’re asking for more of your effort, however the more information we have, the faster we can find the reason behind the problem and fix it. You can also reach out to us directly on our Discord server.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]See you on Guntama Roads![/p][p]Let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p][/p][p]P.S. notes.title: A month after launch
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1][p][/p][p]It’s already been a month since we launched the game. Time flies, doesn’t it? We’ve introduced various fixes, adjustments and even new features in the past four weeks and we’re far from stopping now. We’re knee deep into the post-launch development and we felt it was prudent to provide a summary and showcase what’s to come in the immediate future.
[/p][p]First off, don’t expect a patch this week - we know we’ve accustomed you to bringing a fresh update every Thursday since launch, but this time we’re preparing something bigger and it needs a little bit more time to test out before we ship it. 
[/p][p]From other news that you might have missed this past week - JDM: Japanese Drift Master has been added to the GeForce NOW library, so if you’re a subscriber to the service, be sure to check the game out! 
[/p][h2]What’s done, what’s next?[/h2][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Our main focus right now is the addition of the FSR upscaler, it should be ready next week for all of you. This will become the latest improvement introduced for the game’s performance out of a plethora of additional fixes and adjustments we have already released since May 21st. From optimization tweaks done in the event levels and the open world, through improving shadow quality on ultra settings and adding additional visual features to lower graphics settings, to finally enabling Instanced Occlusion, which reduces the overall GPU strain. We’ve also introduced precompiling shaders on game launch (hidden under the initial loading screen), a warning prompt for getting low on VRAM, as well as drastically reduced stutters during the narrative events.[/p][p][/p][p]Since release, we have fixed various crashes and freezes which were reported to us by the community. If your PC is up to minimum specs, you should no longer have any issues with launching the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We introduced Cloud Saves and a local save backup system, and the ability to disable the HUD for the fans of capturing breathtaking footage of your wonderful cars in action.[/p][p][/p][p]Last but not least, we’ve squashed dozens of bugs that spoiled the fun of playing JDM: car parts issues, side mission issues, main story event issues, as well as UI and audio problems. In other words, it’s been one hell of a busy launch window for us.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/cdf75b95415fd06c7bf6d6dce3cbee5fc8b9441a.png"][/img][/p][p]Obviously, we’re not stopping here. Our efforts, alongside the FSR mentioned earlier, are currently focused on the input feedback we have received from you - we’re digging into the oversteering problems for certain steering wheels, tweaking Force Feedback options and looking into driving assists, as well as working on bringing more input presets to the game. We are also aware that a part of you still has issues with binding some of your peripheral devices, most commonly handbrakes - we’re testing as many of these devices as we can right now.  [/p][p][/p][p]Steam Deck users should also be happy to hear that we are working on proper optimization for handheld devices. There’s still work to be done, but it’s progressing, so be on the lookout for more information in the near future. [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Not all of the fixes mentioned above will find their way into the next week’s patch but a lot will, at least to some degree, as we continue to upgrade the game alongside your feedback. We also have some unexpected content and features surprises lined up for you, so please stay tuned and be on the lookout for more news next week. [/p][p][/p][p]Remember, if you encounter any issues, please send a bug report directly to us [url="https://jdmgame.com/drift-hub/bug-reports/"][u]HERE[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We also invite everyone to join our Discord server, where you can talk to like-minded people and to us directly. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/132bc4ccfad8b23c2ea01fe80251f4b8e7e9f6f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s Drift![/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p]
[/p][hr][p] [/p][/hr][h3]GAMING FACTORY - UPCOMING RELEASES[/h3][p]We're not only a developer but also a publisher. If you like JDM, take a look at what other titles we have gearing up for launch. Who knows, maybe you'll come to love them, as much as we do! 

Thanks!

notes.title: Cloud Saves are coming to JDM on June 12, 2025!
notes.notes:
[h2]Good news, Drifters![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Cloud Saves are rolling into JDM: Japanese Drift Master on [b]June 12, 2025[/b], meaning your game progress will be not only more secure than ever, but also shared between the devices you play on. We are aware that this is a feature that a lot of players have been asking for, so… here it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/cd9f5993d2aa6a8970aa1c3f10bf072194909a6e.png[/img]

[h3]Please note:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Once Steam Cloud is enabled, only one save file will be stored per account. Remember to be careful, as if you use the same account on multiple PCs or PC and Steamdeck, the saved data from the device you launch first will overwrite the data on any device launched later.

And so, if you prefer to keep different save files on separate devices, we recommend turning off Steam Cloud sync in your Steam client before launching the game.

For more information on Cloud Saves, head to the official [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/68D2-35AB-09A9-7678]Steam guide[/url]. Happy drifting!

notes.title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master review
notes.notes:
I have spun out on wet tarmac again and I am furious with myself. JDM: Japanese Drift Master requires a different mentality to most other racing games. Drifting around a corner is not the side gimmick that you'll do a few times during races. Drifting is the race. In this self-described "simcade" game, you've got to slide around the bendy roads of sunny (and rainy) Japan while delivering sushi and chasing boy racers for style points. It all adds up to some remarkably weighty speedfreakery that is bitingly frustrating when I'm bad at it, and rumblingly compelling when I'm good at it.

notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1]

You folks are awesome! Thank you for joining us on Guntama streets. It’s hard to describe the joy of seeing you all share your playthroughs and screenshots on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/44VFMPTVtb]Discord[/url][/b]. The discussions are lively, and there’s a lot of support coming from the community, not only for us but for all of the other members of our JDM family - seriously, you’re among the best people!

With your support, we’ve already managed to cross [b]over 1000 reviews[/b], and more are coming by the minute. Thanks for taking the time to share your thoughts. We also encourage everyone to write a few words about their experience, if you haven’t done so already.

The media have also taken an interest in the project, with hours of content being published by various influencers and traditional media outlets providing their reviews. Thank you for playing JDM! 

We’re being praised for the atmosphere and the authenticity of the experience, while some technical issues remain to be resolved. 

[h3]"JDM: Japanese Drift Master is a hugely ambitious and earnest racer that’s very clearly in love with the art of drifting..." -- IGN[/h3]

[h3]"Bursting with ideas, enthusiasm, and a solid physics model..." -- PC Gamer[/h3]

[h3]"JDM: Japanese Drift Master lets you drift swiftly through a fictional, yet painstakingly detailed area of Japan like no other racing game does." -- Eurogamer[/h3]

Opinions like these are pushing us even harder to make [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/][b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b][/url] one of the best racing experiences on the market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/a865e2ec848738ecb1d08a6f2811640532b0df70.jpg[/img]
[hr] [/hr]
As mentioned above, we didn’t avoid hiccups - some issues are still waiting to be resolved. We’re reading every single comment on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1153410/discussions/]Discussion Forums here on Steam[/url] and following your feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/44VFMPTVtb][b]Discord channels[/b][/url]. We hear you. We’re working hard preparing fixes, and we’ve already released the first patch resolving most issues plaguing the Force Feedback implementation. 

[h2]Hotfix 01[/h2]
We’ve pushed another round of fixes today. Here are the patch notes:

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved game performance when moving through sections of the world map.
[*] Added a set of precompiled shaders on game launch.
[*] Improved performance during main story missions - stuttering should now be minimized or gone alltogether.
[*] Improved overal game performance during Story Events
[*] We're still working on a proper graphical preset for Steam Deck, however for now we've introduced small optimization changes that should provide around 5 - 15FPS gain globally.
[/list]
[h3]Game Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Disabled Chromatic Aberration.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mirror Quality Settings would reset after a game restart.
[/list]
[h3]Story Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue blocking progress in Chapter 05 Mission 01.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Locked the possibility to sell your last car.
[*] Fixed the reputation notification system, which incorrectly prompted the same notification multiple times. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Xbox 360 and the Xbox Elite 2 Controllers would incorrectly recognise a single press of the (A) button as a 'double tap'. 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could not bet in the Underground Side Missions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera setting would reset to default after completing the Sushi Delivery Side Mission.
[/list]
[h3]Audio [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the audio levels when launching the game in cockpit view - the sound levels will now remain at inded levels on all camera views.
[/list]
[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Achievements "Gaijin", "Dojin" and "Tourist" would not display the proper mileage count
[/list]More fixes are incoming, so please stay tuned.

notes.title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master - OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1]

Here it is, the finish line! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/][b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b][/url] is out now! You can grab a copy with a launch discount between today and June 04. There’s [b]250km of an open world[/b] ready for you to explore, a [b]full single player story campaign[/b], one of the most [b]robust tuning systems[/b] in a racing game, [b]two different driving models[/b] (simcade and arcade), drift, grip and drag event races, and [b]fully licensed, legendary cars[/b] coming from the biggest Japanese manufacturers. In other words - it’s a lot of content for you to enjoy! 

[h2]Ladies and Gentlemen, Let’s Drift![/h2]

[previewyoutube=-iebhqKtmcg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]I’ve launched the game, what now?[/h2]
First and foremost, obviously have fun! We’re continuing to work on the game: from optimization improvements, quality of life improvements, to future game content. Any and all feedback you might have for us is more than welcome.

The game starts with a [b]tutorial[/b], which eases you into the most basic mechanics of the game, including how to initiate a drift. It’s also the beginning of the story. After its completion (you can also skip it from the Pause Menu) the open world lies at your disposal - feel free to explore Guntama or travel to the next story mission that’s unlocked on your map. You can repeat any of the completed missions directly from your [b]in-game smartphone[/b] - it’s a good way to improve your score or even get some additional cash. 

Engage in side activities, like the Sushi Delivery Missions or Underground Races to gain more money and ultimately buy new cars as well as tuning parts for them. With game progress you will unlock additional garages for even more car storage. [b]Garages also serve as fast travel points[/b], so do remember that if you want to get somewhere at the far end of a map faster.

From the Main Menu you can also access a [b]Challenge Mode[/b], where players compete for the score in either grip or drift races. The scores are public and visible on leaderboards - it’s the first element of a larger multiplayer feature that we want to add into the game in the future. Additionally, doing Challenge runs earns you some additional cash. Note that you need to score a minimal time requirement or drift points for the score to be recorded. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/e594291e2875f4205c893a12621fcb2998785533.png[/img]
[hr] [/hr]
[h2]What’s new today? Patch Notes[/h2]
If you’re following what’s happening with JDM, you might have seen some gameplay footage being published by influencers for the past week. Today, with the full public release, we’re bringing some new features into the game:

[h3]New Open World Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Sushi Delivery[/b] - When roaming the open world you may stumble upon a Sushi Delivery event. Deliver the package in as good as possible condition, while driving with style, to earn additional money. 
[*] [b]Underground Races[/b] - Found when driving through the open world.  There are two variations of this event: grip or drift focused. Bet your cash for a chance to win even more money, but you will need to show your skill first - earn enough points (drift) or make it to the finish line in the allocated time (grip) to get the reward. The more money you will bet, the more difficult the challenge will be. 
[/list] 
[h3]Difficulty Settings[/h3]
We’ve added three difficulty settings to the game: Easy, Medium, Hard. They are accessible from the [b]Main Menu[/b] or the [b]Pause Menu[/b], under the Assists and Driving Settings. The new difficulty settings are scaling how well the AI opponents behave on track: how well they build-up their scores and how aggressively they drive on tracks during events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/275f3255d8946af93d78f1a64033047e944139fc.png[/img]
[h3]Additional patch notes include:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]General Traffic AI improvements[/b] - cars in the traffic should behave more rationally. Their spawning points and animations have been improved.
[*] [b]Traffic intensity optimization[/b] - we’ve optimized the amount of cars spawning on different graphics quality settings to improve the overall game’s performance.
[*] [b]Traffic on/off option[/b] - we’ve added the option to turn the traffic on or off at any time - a perfect solution for people who want to master those tight corners in the open world. You can find this setting in the Assists & Driving options from the Game Menu or Pause Menu. 
[*] [b]Force Feedback[/b] - fixed the issues with force feedback technology when driving using a steering wheel.
[*] [b]Upscaler fixes[/b] - fixed issues with FSR and XeSS upscaling technology.
[*] [b]Story Campaign events [/b]- fixed minor issues with a variety of events for the Main Story Campaign.
[/list]
[hr] [/hr]
[h2]Supported steering wheels[/h2]
A good portion of you fine people will want to play using your steering wheels. Know that we’re tirelessly working on bringing more and more plug&play presets for you, but as of today this is the list of steering wheels that we fully support.
[list]
[*] Fanatec Podium DD2
[*] Fanatec CSL DD
[*] Fanatec_GT_DD
[*] Moza R5
[*] Moza R9
[*] Simagic_Alpha_GT1
[*] Logitech G29
[*] Logitech G923  + pedals (PS)
[*] Logitech G923  + pedals (Xbox)
[*] Logitech PRO Racing Wheel #1
[*] Logitech G920
[*] Thrustmaster T150
[*] Thrustmaster T300
[*] Trustmaster_T-GT_II
[*] Thrustmaster_TS-XW_Racer
[*] Thrustmaster_TX_RW
[*] Thrustmaster TMX
[*] Thrustmaster T500RS
[*] PXN v10  + pedals
[*] Turtle Beach VelocityOne Race
[/list]
If your device is not on the list, don’t worry, we’ve built a whole robust custom binding system in the game. You can use it to map out any device you want to play on. 

For more details take a look at our guide here:

[previewyoutube=vbrxo4KaT6A;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr] [/hr]
[h2]The infancy problems[/h2]
We’ve playtested, debugged and double-checked everything before launch, but you know what? We might have missed something. That something may result in a serious issue for you, which is a situation we really don’t want to happen…but it might.

If it comes down to this, please use our Bug and Issues form, that you can find here - [url=https://jdmgame.com/drift-hub/bug-reports/][b]Bug and Issues Form[/b][/url] (the link will take you to our webpage).
You will also be able to access this form directly from the game, from the [b]Main Menu > Bug Reporting[/b] button.

Using the form is the best way for us to see your issues, however we will still be looking through the Forums, reading our emails and looking at Reddit, but it will always be a less efficient way to contact us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/cbbf5931a39922c5e6e41f9f76901aad75bc3ffa.png[/img]
[hr] [/hr]
[h2]What’s next for JDM?[/h2]
Today’s release is just a start. We’re planning to grow, evolve and expand the game in the upcoming months (hopefully years!) to come. 

We’re a small team and we can’t push out every single feature we’d want immediately, which is why we’ve put certain milestones in front of us. Something for you to look forward to. Here’s a gist:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/00f795c1467f21d73620faea1e5f9cdc0cbf5959.png[/img]
It’s but a glimpse into our plans, but it will give you a rough idea on what our priorities will be in the months ahead. 

[hr] [/hr]
[h2]We’ve made it![/h2]
Once again folks, [b]THANK YOU[/b] for being part of the community. For your support, insights, comments and critique. We’ve done it together! 
To celebrate, here’s a commemorative Key Art variation for launch date:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/832a482f3fe0d89b7dac68c4bfbe3a2951647dcb.png[/img]

We hope you have a blast roaming the streets of Guntama, following the story of Touma and flying sideways through those tight mountain corners.

notes.title: It’s finally happening!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1]

A little over [b]24 hours left[/b] until you can all join us on the streets of Guntama, how awesome is that?! We’re buzzing here with energy and anticipation - years of our hard labour will finally be available for all to play. It’s a beautiful moment! Nerve-wrecking and stressful, but also wonderful and joyful! We really went all out with this project - both in terms of ambition and the amount of sweat poured on our keyboards during the development process. We hope that it will be a dream-come-true game for you folks, as it always has been for us. 

[h3][b]On this special day, we wanted to take five minutes out of your time to properly thank you! [/b][/h3]

We’re deeply bowing to all of the community members, who have been with us for this wild development ride. To all of the commenters, critics, comedians and diehard fans - this game couldn’t happen without you and your input! 

Taking the chance, we would also like to specifically extend our gratitude to all of the mods on our [url=https://discord.gg/44VFMPTVtb]Discord[/url] channel who kept (and still are keeping) the communication running flawlessly. You’ve been a tremendous help, thank you. 

[h3]Thank you to all of our partners: [/h3]
[b]Intel[/b], for being our reliable technological partner. Especially for all of the support and mentorship during the development. 

[b]Nissan[/b], [b]Mazda[/b], [b]Honda[/b], [b]Subaru[/b], for believing in our indie project and providing car licences that came with these partnerships.

[b]Logitech G[/b], [b]Thrustmaster[/b], [b]Moza[/b], [b]Simagic[/b], [b]Fanatec[/b], [b]Hori[/b], [b]PXN[/b], [b]Flash Fire[/b], for providing hardware and the know-how to bring as many input devices as possible into the game.

[b]Playseat[/b], [b]ADBL[/b], for all your help, support, licences and knowledge shared.

notes.title: Adjust the controls your way!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1]

The release of[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/][b] JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b][/url] is just around the corner – it launches on[b] May 21[/b], which means there are only [b]5 days to go[/b]! 

The countdown is almost over, and we can’t wait for you to hit the streets of Japan and start your drifting journey! We’ve prepared a [b]Key Binding Guide[/b] that walks you through customizing your controls, whether you’re playing with a keyboard, gamepad, or steering wheel. This guide will make sure you’re ready to take on every corner, every drift, and every challenge from the moment you fire up the game.

[h2]Check out our guide video:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=vbrxo4KaT6A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Setting Up Your Controls in JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/h3]
When you [b]first launch the game[/b], JDM will automatically detect all connected input devices (keyboard, gamepad, steering wheel, etc.). You’ll be prompted to select your preferred input, and when you do, a pop-up will appear with suggested default key bindings.

But don’t worry — nothing is final. You can [b]change your input device[/b] or [b]rebind any key[/b] at any time:
[list]
[*] from the [b]Main Settings[/b] menu
[*] or directly in the [b]Pause Menu[/b] during gameplay.
[/list]
If you plug in a new device later, [b]the game will detect it automatically[/b].

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Gamepads – Presets & Customization[/h3]
We’ve prepared two different presets for gamepad users, but if neither suits your style, you can go to the input settings, rebind any button manually, and create a custom layout that works best for you.

[h3]Steering Wheel Setup & Custom Binding Guide[/h3]
We aim to support as many steering wheels as possible in plug & play mode, but if your device doesn’t work out of the box, here’s how to set it up manually:
[list]
[*] [b]Check if your device is detected[/b]
Look at the [i]left side of the input settings screen[/i]. Press any button on the wheel to confirm that the input is working.
[*] [b]Assign controls[/b]
Click on the button you want to remap, then press the desired button, axis or pedal on your device to assign it to the selected action.
[*] [b]Set up menu navigation[/b]
Go to the [i]Menu actions[/i] section to assign buttons for navigating menus (e.g., accept, back, etc.).
[*] [b]Save your preset[/b]
Press the [i]green “Save” button[/i] to save your custom layout. The game will remind you to save before exiting, so you don’t lose your setup.
[/list]
[i]If you're playing on a wheel, we highly recommend switching to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1153410/view/510705212398241200]Simcade Driving Model[/url]. It offers a more realistic and satisfying driving experience that matches the feel of a steering wheel.[/i]

[h3]You're ready to hit the road on May 21![/h3]
With your controls set up and key bindings tailored to your style, you're all set to start your drifting journey in [b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b]. Whether you're a keyboard warrior, gamepad drifter, or wheel enthusiast, we've got you covered.

notes.title: A Driving Experience for Everyone
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1]

The robust world of racing video games is filled with different experiences: from pure arcade models, in which you never take your foot off the gas pedal, to highly sophisticated simulations that take into account tire wear. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/][b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b][/url] lands somewhere between these two options as an example of the simcade genre.

We crafted JDM to have a solid, realistic, physics-based driving model as the game’s backbone. This means you won’t be able to take a hairpin corner going 200 km/h, but you will be able to fully enjoy drifting on your steering wheel. On top of that, we added a few layers of arcade elements - toning down a little bit the difficulty of handling the car, while still preserving the realism of the experience. This is our [b]Simcade Driving Model[/b], but we didn’t stop there.

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/][b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b][/url], you will have two Driving Models at your disposal. [b]Simcade[/b], as described above, and [b]Arcade[/b]. Check out our latest video guide, in which we make a deeper dive into the differences between the two.

[previewyoutube=keEhPpSuMOw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Play the way you like[/h2]
The [b]Arcade[/b] driving model is a gameplay style designed for players who prioritize fun and easy-to-learn controls over maximum realism. After selecting this mode, you will have your ABS, ESP, Drift Assist, and Brake Assist enabled. If you don’t call yourself a simracer, it’s the best place to start your adventure with JDM. 

The [b]Simcade[/b] setup is a gameplay style designed for players who prefer more realism in vehicle handling. After selecting this mode, you will have your ABS on, and your ESP, Drift Assist, and  Brake Assist disabled. You will have more control over the car’s behaviour, but it will require more skill to do so.

When first launching the game, you will be prompted to select the preferred model. You will also be able to make the change at any time from the [b]Pause Menu[/b] option, so feel free to experiment and find what works best for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/a28c9c976e11ef0b3b5be7cc56e003cbd885ecef.png[/img]
Each racing game enthusiast has their preferred taste for driving mechanics, but we are sure that with the addition of two driving models, you will feel right at home with JDM.

If you like what you see, please remember to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/]wishlist[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/]follow[/url] the game on Steam.

notes.title: JDM’s campaign and events!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ossu![/h1]

If you’ve been following our devlogs, you know what to expect when [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/][b]JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b][/url] releases on [b]May 21[/b]. However, there’s still one big question mark that we haven’t officially tackled and discussed in more detail - what’s the gameplay loop like? What to expect from a ‘minute-to-minute’ experience, which you will delve into on launch?

To best illustrate, here’s a fresh new RAW gameplay from the game, captured from the end of Chapter 01, where Touma faces off with Scorpion. We quickly clicked through the story pages to avoid bigger spoilers, but be warned - you will find a few of them in the footage below. 

[previewyoutube=0YSWsiD5Fx0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Story Campaign[/h2]
You play as [i]Touma[/i], a Polish drifter, who comes to Japan to restart his life. With the help of a few friends, he gets up on his feet and starts to compete in local racing events, growing his reputation and building a name for himself. The story is told through a series of events/missions intertwined with manga pages. 

You always start in the open world, riding out of your garage. The game will then mark the next Story event on your map, which will progress the narrative. When you drive to the spot, you will be able to interact with a marker and launch the next mission. The event will most often open up with a manga page (or a few) and then proceed to the race. After completion, you will be back in the open world, and a new marker will show up on your map. 

Of course, you don’t need to push story events one after another, the whole game world is open for you from the moment you step out of your garage, so it’s up to you if you want to roam around Guntama in between the Main Story events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021335/524c2b88804f42d7dda2eeac6b60b3230de8e601.png[/img]
[h2]Story Events[/h2]
During the campaign, you will take part in a plethora of events: some happening directly on the streets of Guntama, some on dedicated racing tracks (which you will also be able to visit from the open world at any time). You will compete in drifting events - where style points decide the winners, or in grip races, in which you have to cross the finish line first. Sometimes, you will need to be first AND race in the best style, so take notice of the win conditions during each event.

Story Events do not need to be connected to a race - without spoiling too much, let us only say that you will work for a sushi restaurant and you will be challenged by various characters to show off your skills. You will also make a few enemies on your journey, so expect chases to be part of the experience.
